func_08000980_6ACED0.title: Advance a spike floor
func_08000980_6ACED0.summary: Initializes and advances the periodic spike-floor actor, including its subtype-specific delay and local collision admission.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Live actor task for entity 0x3CA in File 24.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The task object at task +0x18, with native animation resources bound during phase 0.

behavior: The callback keeps its identity throughout the cycle. Task byte +0xD4 selects phase 0 initialization, phase 1 waiting, phase 3 extension, or phase 4 retraction. Phase 2 has no body.

Phase 0 binds local animation and command resources once. Immutable task halfwords +0xD0 and +0xD2 contain the placement subtype and delay seed copied from definition +0x04 and +0x06. Subtype 0 uses seed times 6 and reset 155; subtype 1 uses seed times 4 and reset 90; subtype 2 uses ((20 minus seed) times 20) modulo 130 and reset 90.

Phase 1 decrements the unsigned halfword at +0x8A. Observing its old value zero emits positional sound 0x271, starts animation, and enters phase 3. The stored countdown is then 0xFFFF until the cycle resets.

Phase 3 waits for object byte +0x7C completion bit 0x02, sets task reverse mask 0x01000000, clears completion, and starts retraction at frame 2.0. Phase 4 waits for completion, clears reverse and play bits, copies signed reset halfword +0xD6 into countdown +0x8A, and returns to phase 1.

Subtype 2 updates task flag bits 0xC0 after every phase using the local player object: the bits are set only while the absolute Z distance is less than 30.0. Other subtypes retain these bits from initialization.
The callback does not dispatch contact, damage, awards, child creation, save flags, or room transitions. The separately scheduled common actor post callback still handles contact.
cautions: Use the full ROM-qualified symbol: File 24 shares its virtual address range with other overlays. This callback is not a general actor initializer.
Do not invoke phase 0 again to restore a running actor. It rebinds resources and resets the local cycle. Do not call the callback as an observation probe: it mutates timers and can emit sound.
Do not copy object pointers, task command pointers, or subtype-2 local player collision-admission bits between actors. Preserve the native common post callback and its normal contact cadence.
Animation resource 0x24F and common resource 0x152 must be resident. Animation binding and resource ownership belong to the native actor lifecycle.
func_08000980_6ACED0.exampleExplanation: The entry hook only samples the current phase and raw countdown. The native callback continues once through its normal scheduler path. During extension or retraction, countdown 0xFFFF is expected and is not a fresh waiting delay.
